cards.name: Caterpie
cards.description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

cards.name: Swadloon
cards.description: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

cards.name: Charjabug
cards.description: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.description: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

cards.name: Zeraora
cards.description: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.description: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.description: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.description: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.description: It has an electrical organ on its chest. While generating electricity, it fills its surroundings with what sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.description: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

cards.name: Leavanny
cards.description: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.description: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!

cards.name: Jynx
cards.description: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.description: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.description: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

cards.name: Galarian Corsola
cards.description: Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient kind of Corsola. This Pokémon absorbs others' life-force through its branches.

cards.name: Galarian Cursola
cards.description: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You'll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Maractus
cards.description: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They're jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.description: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Munna
cards.description: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it's eating a good dream, and black when it's eating a nightmare.

cards.name: Musharna
cards.description: It drowses and dreams all the time. It's best to leave it be if it's just woken up, as it's a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.description: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.description: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.description: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

cards.name: Indeedee
cards.description: They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.

cards.name: Dreepy
cards.description: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

cards.name: Drakloak
cards.description: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it'll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

cards.name: Shelmet
cards.description: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

cards.name: Dragapult
cards.description: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult's horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.description: When its skin gets wrinkled from moisture, it heads for a volcano. It lies flat on a spot with a lot of geothermal heat and dries itself out.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.description: Thanks to its thick claws, it's good at climbing trees. There are plenty of Sandslash that park themselves in trees and go right to sleep.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.description: If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.description: The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.description: It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs. People who see it in action have been known to take up bouldering.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.description: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

cards.name: Golem
cards.description: It detonates its own body. The power from that explosion can propel it up steep mountain paths with amazing speed.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.description: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

cards.name: Accelgor
cards.description: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.description: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.description: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.description: There's a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

cards.name: Hariyama
cards.description: Hariyama that are big and fat aren't necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.description: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.description: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.description: It's a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

cards.name: Landorus
cards.description: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.description: Wanting to make sure it's taken seriously, Pancham's always giving others a glare. But if it's not focusing, it ends up smiling.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.description: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.description: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.description: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

cards.name: Clobbopus
cards.description: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

cards.name: Grapploct
cards.description: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

cards.name: Falinks
cards.description: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

cards.name: Falinks
cards.description: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

cards.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
cards.description: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.description: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

cards.name: Galarian Linoone
cards.description: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

cards.name: Galarian Obstagoon
cards.description: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.description: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.description: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

cards.name: Absol
cards.description: The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: Once diluted, its poison becomes medicinal. This Pokémon came into popularity after a pharmaceutical company chose it as a mascot.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.description: It booms out a victory croak when its prey goes down in defeat. This Pokémon and Seismitoad are related species.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.description: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.description: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.description: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.description: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon's feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.description: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.description: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.description: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

cards.name: Mandibuzz
cards.description: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.description: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.description: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

cards.name: Impidimp
cards.description: It sneaks into people's homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

cards.name: Morgrem
cards.description: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

cards.name: Grimmsnarl
cards.description: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.description: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.description: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

cards.name: Galarian Meowth
cards.description: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.

cards.name: Galarian Perrserker
cards.description: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.description: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.description: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

cards.name: Durant
cards.description: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

cards.name: Klefki
cards.description: Long ago it lived in mines, but once the minerals that make up its diet became scarcer, Klefki began appearing in human settlements.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.description: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

cards.name: Meltan
cards.description: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

cards.name: Melmetal
cards.description: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.description: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

cards.name: Corviknight
cards.description: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region's airborne taxi service.

cards.name: Cufant
cards.description: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

cards.name: Copperajah
cards.description: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

cards.name: Latias
cards.description: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

cards.name: Latios
cards.description: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

cards.name: Goomy
cards.description: Their horns are powerful sensors. As soon as Goomy pick up any sign of enemies, they go into hiding. This is how they've survived.

cards.name: Sliggoo
cards.description: The lump on its back contains its tiny brain. It thinks only of food and escaping its enemies.

cards.name: Goodra
cards.description: Its form of offense is forcefully stretching out its horns. The strikes land 100 times harder than any blow from a heavyweight boxer.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.description: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn't get along with Galarian Meowth.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.description: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.description: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

cards.name: Persian
cards.description: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.description: Because the eggs on their bellies have been overharvested by people in the past, the Chansey population remains very small.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.description: This Pokémon is overflowing with love. Only Chansey that share a strong bond with their Trainer can evolve, so people say.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.description: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.description: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.description: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.description: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.description: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.description: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.description: The reason it keeps one ear rolled up is so it can launch a swift counterattack if it's attacked by an enemy.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.description: It's notably wary and has a dislike of fighting, but at the same time, it can deliver powerful kicks with its lithe legs.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.description: It's very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight's flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

cards.name: Diggersby
cards.description: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.description: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

cards.name: Rookidee
cards.description: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

cards.name: Corvisquire
cards.description: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent's strength.

cards.name: Wooloo
cards.description: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

cards.name: Wooloo
cards.description: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

cards.name: Dubwool
cards.description: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

cards.name: Gossifleur
cards.description: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

cards.name: Eldegoss
cards.description: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

cards.name: Zarude
cards.description: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.description: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.description: A Pokémon that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.description: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.description: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

cards.name: Victini
cards.description: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.description: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.description: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.description: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.description: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

cards.name: Sizzlipede
cards.description: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

cards.name: Sizzlipede
cards.description: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

cards.name: Centiskorch
cards.description: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

cards.name: Centiskorch
cards.description: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.description: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.description: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.description: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.description: No number of injuries can bother Staryu. Its amazing regenerative powers return it to its previous state in half a day!

cards.name: Starmie
cards.description: It rotates its geometrically shaped body to swim through the water. It always seems to be sending out mysterious radio waves.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.description: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.description: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.description: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

cards.name: Marill
cards.description: Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That's why this Pokémon is never cold.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.description: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.description: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.description: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if Remoraid attach to it to scavenge for its leftovers.

cards.name: Mudkip
cards.description: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

cards.name: Marshtomp
cards.description: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.

cards.name: Swampert
cards.description: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

cards.name: Clamperl
cards.description: Clamperl's pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder's pearls.

cards.name: Huntail
cards.description: Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.

cards.name: Gorebyss
cards.description: It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

cards.name: Simipour
cards.description: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.description: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

cards.name: Basculin
cards.description: Known for their violence, these Pokémon have the most fights with schools of red-striped Basculin.

cards.name: Galarian Darumaka
cards.description: The colder they get, the more energetic they are. They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.

cards.name: Galarian Darmanitan
cards.description: Though it has a gentle disposition, it's also very strong. It will quickly freeze the snowball on its head before going for a headbutt.

cards.name: Clauncher
cards.description: It moves around by jetting water from its right pincer. It has a poor sense of balance, so it's terrible at swimming straight.

cards.name: Clawitzer
cards.description: Its right arm is packed with meat. When its pincer falls off, it's exported to be used as a cooking ingredient.

cards.name: Pyukumuku
cards.description: It's covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

cards.name: Simisage
cards.description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

cards.name: Chewtle
cards.description: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

cards.name: Drednaw
cards.description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

cards.name: Arrokuda
cards.description: After it's eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That's when Cramorant swallows it up.

cards.name: Barraskewda
cards.description: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

cards.name: Snom
cards.description: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

cards.name: Frosmoth
cards.description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.description: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.description: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

cards.name: Minun
cards.description: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.description: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.description: With a body made of plasma, it can inhabit all sorts of machines. It loves to surprise others.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.description: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.description: The sun powers this Pokémon's electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.description: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.
